open_questions: WINDOW: events fire only at slots (cycle-1) % event_interval == 0, so cycles 5 and 9 inside cycles 1-10, drawn from a pool of about 36. Each branch event will rarely fire. Widen the window, add weight or lower event_interval?

VISIBILITY: Luxury needs silk or musk (system 2 permit) and Minerals needs ore (FND_PROSPECT) before cycle 10; Military uses energy and Biotech food (visible at start). Many runs will never see EV53 or EV54 inside the window. Reported, not widened.

Chain gains reading: I removed half of the chain OPTIONS that have a gets list (a step always keeps one option, so a spotted run sees single-button steps), not whole steps, since removing steps would break requires_prev_step chains. Is that what you want?
